scope: 48 verified pointer interactions plus 10 Command-Tab / pointer return sequences. No concurrent build during recording. Same opt-in GPUI instrumentation as paired before/after. All startup/warmup events retained. Presentation measures platform drawing/encoding/submission on CPU, not OS input queue or GPU scanout.
